hypotheses.B0_own_weight_basis_is_sufficient: Every family's own rank-8 residual input basis reaches at least 0.85 output fidelity.
hypotheses.B1_payload_bases_are_family_specific: For at least three target families, own-basis fidelity exceeds the best other-family basis by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.B2_payload_input_subspaces_are_geometric: Every pair of family input bases has normalized projector overlap below 0.30.
hypotheses.B3_geometric_overlap_predicts_causal_cro: Across off-diagonal pairs, projector overlap and causal cross-basis fidelity correlate at least 0.50.
hypotheses.B4_own_bases_beat_random: Every own basis exceeds the mean matched-random basis by at least 0.30 fidelity.
